name: Hill Sprints
instructions: Find a hill with a moderate incline, around 50 to 100 meters long. Start at the base and sprint upward at maximum effort, driving your knees high and pumping your arms.
Lean slightly into the hill and shorten your stride compared to flat sprinting. Walk back down to the start to recover fully before repeating.
The incline reduces impact on the joints while increasing demand on the glutes and hamstrings. Hill sprints are an efficient way to build both power and cardiovascular capacity.
